title: docs(agents): a local `merge-tree` of an os-regen path is not GitHub mergeability — state the corollary and name the sound probe (#15871)
body:
Fixes #15871
Part of #15815 — the GOVERNED half. The ordinary half (the same text in `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`'s header, plus the driver's probe gate) is PR #15868.

`AGENTS.md` §11 already says the `merge=os-regen` driver is a LOCAL facility. The corollary was nowhere stated: a local `merge-tree` of a routed path is not evidence about GitHub's mergeability. This adds it as one bullet, immediately after that sentence. Nothing else in `AGENTS.md`; no `CLAUDE.md` mirror (no gate demanded one).

## Ceiling raise — ruled

The ratchet ceiling for `AGENTS.md` in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` moves **1058 → 1068**, headroom 0, by the header's own escape hatch: a maintainer ruling quoted in this PR.

**Ruling 1** — decision batch #63, 2026-09-07, comment 5564103435. Maintainer reply, verbatim and untranslated:

> 「同意」

which adopted "the line ratchet on `AGENTS.md` rises … for this PR's ten-line corollary (local `merge-tree` is not GitHub mergeability; probe from a driver-less bare clone; ⛔ never `-c merge.os-regen.driver=`). Re-wrap and cross-file moves were correctly refused; this is the header's escape hatch."

**Ruling 2** — the correction, 2026-09-07, comment 5567414563. Maintainer reply, verbatim and untranslated:

> 「15885 你接手跟进合并」

Batch #63 stated the number as 1162 → 1171 and sequenced this PR before #15856. That sequencing was already false when written: #15856 (the rules-only rewrite) merged on 2026-09-05 as `abdceef8c`, and `AGENTS.md` on `main` is now 1058 with the ceiling re-pinned to 1058. The ruling's **substance** stands — the ten-line corollary is approved and its raise is the escape hatch — and the **number is re-measured** here, mechanically, at the landed count.

`AGENTS.md` is **not** a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` destination (verified: `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` holds exactly one key, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`), so no `ruledRaises` record applies — batch #63's mention of one is withdrawn by the correction. `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` and every other ceiling are untouched.

## What this patch round did

1. **Merged `origin/main`** into the branch (a merge commit; no rebase, no amend, no force-push). Clean: merge tree `ad22eca70e3b08f1ec764511161754a26686549c`, `AGENTS.md` = 1068 lines, the bullet landing at §11 lines 586–595 directly under the "**The driver is a LOCAL facility**" sentence it anchors to.
2. **Re-typeset the bullet in #15856's rules-only voice.** The incident clause "and it has already cost a seat a round trip" is out. Every rule sentence stays: the corollary; the mechanism (merge-ort honours the custom driver, GitHub runs none, so the two answer different questions); the driver-less bare-clone probe with both commands; the ⛔ `-c merge.os-regen.driver=` refusal with its reason. Re-wrapped to the surrounding block's own prose width — **widest added line 90 bytes**, against 90 bytes widest in the surrounding §11 block (the gate's hard cap is 120). Every inline code span is balanced within its line.
3. **Raised the ceiling** with an entry comment in the neighbouring style quoting both rulings verbatim and untranslated.

Exactly two files change: `AGENTS.md` (the one bullet) and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (one `CEILINGS` entry + its comment).

## The added text, exactly as committed

```
   - **Corollary — a local `merge-tree` is NOT GitHub's mergeability**: a local
     `git merge-tree` of any `merge=os-regen` path runs the same merge-ort machinery as
     `git merge` and therefore honours the custom driver, while GitHub runs none, so the
     two answer different questions about the same snapshot. Probe from a throwaway bare
     clone that shares the object store and has no driver registered
     (`git clone --bare --shared . PROBE.git`, then
     `git --git-dir=PROBE.git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only BASE HEAD`), ⛔ never
     with `-c merge.os-regen.driver=`, which does not disable the driver but leaves git
     failing to run it and reporting a conflict for every routed path, including ones that
     text-merge cleanly.
```

The placeholders are spelled `BASE HEAD` in words rather than in angle brackets, keeping the paragraph quotable in a GitHub body without tripping the body sanitizer.

### Ablation — the raised ceiling is load-bearing

The ceiling was temporarily put back to 1058 and the gate re-run, from a tree where `HEAD` already carries the implementation (so the restore leg points at it). The mutation was proven to reach disk before the reading was taken, and the restore proven by blob hash — not by an exit code:

```

  surface compressed: ... Raising a ceiling requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR.

```

`git diff HEAD` is empty after the restore, and `git status` is clean. Predicted direction was RED, observed direction was RED, with the 1058-vs-1068 message — so the raised ceiling is load-bearing and the gate is not vacuous. The script carried a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restore on absolute paths throughout. Re-run on the restored tree at the final commit: EXIT=**0**, both legs green as quoted above.

Docs + a PM script; publishes nothing from any package ⇒ `skip-changeset` (already labelled).
